note: Rust encounter ratio = final plant_contact_ticks / mouth_contact_enter_events; game same ratio from final contact_ext live records. Gate counts are mouth entries (not plant-specific), so use as relative duration proxy.

tick_rate_normalization.why: capture row tick labels are simTime*30, but final actual ticks=35991 over 900s; game UpdateOrgan/contact counters advance per actual tick
tick_rate_normalization.interpretation: At matched nearest 0-5u both are near the per-update maximum (0.98 vs0.99); in-zone gap drops from48% to10.7%; 1000-2000u Rust is higher per update. The gross per-second gap is mostly the 40-vs-30 tick-rate difference plus occupancy/population weighting, not a mouth behavior shortening contacts.

encounter_interpretation.rust_runs: 159 plant-contact runs over 307,890 records; median433 ticks, p901063, max4034; once acquired, contacts are long and not repeatedly interrupted.
encounter_interpretation.game_proxy: final live plant_contact_ticks/mouth_enter_events mean1159 vs Rust533; different actual ticks and mouth-entry semantics, so use only as relative proxy.
encounter_interpretation.verdict: No evidence for bite knockback/post-bite cooldown/target-expiration shortening Rust contacts. Target counts match; Rust active fraction tracks target presence; active/contact gaps normalise to ~6-11% per update at matched radius. Remaining difference is measurement tick rate + live/lineage weighting; no body mouth patch indicated.
